metadata.title: COMPUTER-BASED STUDENT QUESTIONNAIRE FOR PISA 2022 Main Survey Version

survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This document is a computer-based student questionnaire instrument for PISA 2022 (Main Survey Version), not an empirical analysis paper. It therefore does not specify any analytic sample, weighting variables, or replicate-weight procedures (e.g., BRR/jackknife) for estimation. For any downstream empirical use of PISA 2022 student questionnaire data, analysts should apply the official PISA sampling/replicate weights provided with the PISA microdata to obtain population-representative estimates and correct standard errors under the complex survey design. Because this is an instrument specification, no PV generation, scaling model, or missing-data imputation strategy is described here.

data.handling_not_reported_explanation: Plausible values are not applicable because this is a questionnaire instrument documentation, not an analysis of cognitive achievement outcomes that would use PV-based scoring. Missing-data handling is not reported because the document does not present an empirical dataset analysis or an imputation/deletion strategy; it only lists questionnaire items and response formats. Any missing-data treatment would be determined in the separate PISA data analysis workflow, not in this instrument text.

sample_details.sample_filtering_criteria: Not applicable: this is a questionnaire instrument specification (computer-based student questionnaire for PISA 2022) and does not define an analytic sample or inclusion/exclusion criteria.

data.outcome_summary: This document provides the item-level content and response formats for the PISA 2022 computer-based student questionnaire (Main Survey Version), including demographic background, home resources and digital access, school experiences, learning time and homework, mathematics instruction and tasks, and COVID-19-related schooling experiences. It does not report any student-level achievement outcomes, model estimation, or predictive/causal analyses. As a result, there are no benchmarks, effect sizes, or performance metrics to summarize. The questionnaire is designed to collect contextual and attitudinal variables that are typically linked to PISA cognitive assessment results in separate empirical studies. Because this is instrument documentation, it does not specify plausible value generation, scaling, sampling weights, or missing-data handling procedures.
data.null_fields_interpretation: This extraction is sparse by design because the provided text is an instrument specification rather than an empirical research article. There is no analytic sample, no country coverage, no weighting or replicate design information, and no statistical modeling or ML pipeline described. Consequently, fields related to PV handling, missing-data treatment, and findings are not populated beyond the required framework defaults.
